observations.behavior: Adds a new Node.js script that patches the cargo-dist generated CLI installer to wrap downloads in retry logic.
observations.posthog_connection: This changes how PostHog's CLI is distributed via npm; users downloading the package will experience fewer failed installs due to transient network errors.

observations.behavior: Provides comprehensive tests for transient error classification and the retry mechanism.
observations.posthog_connection: These tests establish confidence that the implementation correctly distinguishes between recoverable and permanent failures before deployment.

observations.behavior: Updates CI workflow to execute the patching step during the release build of the CLI artifact.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes this path without execution or test support would not earn tier 3; however, its inclusion alongside tests supports reliable delivery.

observations.limitations: The change only affects distribution packaging. It does not modify runtime behavior, database operations, query processing, authentication, or core product features. Tier 3 requires broader systemic impact across components or critical paths, which is absent here. No adoption or incident avoidance can be inferred from a single-package patch.

review.limitations: The change only affects distribution packaging. It does not modify runtime behavior, database operations, query processing, authentication, or core product features. Tier 3 requires broader systemic impact across components or critical paths, which is absent here. No adoption or incident avoidance can be inferred from a single-package patch.
review.reason: Adds bounded capability: transient-download recovery with exponential backoff, complete unit and integration coverage, and CI enforcement. This improves reliability of npm package installation but remains localized to one distributed asset rather than changing PostHog’s core functionality or shared infrastructure.
review.posthog_relevance: Relevant to end users who install @posthog/cli via npm; reduces failed installs caused by temporary network issues.
review.uncertainty: None; all hunks are present and executable.
